meta.name: ILUD
meta.tagline: Use the internet with less AI.
meta.description: A researched catalogue of practical ways to turn off, work around, or replace unwanted AI features in the tools people use every day.
meta.maintenance: Every entry carries a confidence level, a verification date and its sources. Entries marked 'experimental' are community-discovered behaviour that platforms may change without notice. Re-check anything older than three months.
meta.disclaimer: ILUD is not affiliated with any of the services it describes. Nothing here asks you to break a rule, bypass payment, or install anything we have not named. Settings move. If a step no longer matches what you see, trust your screen over this page.

approaches.name: Turn it off
approaches.blurb: A real setting exists. Change it once and it stays changed.

approaches.name: Work around it
approaches.blurb: No setting, but there is a reliable way to sidestep the feature.

approaches.name: Use something else
approaches.blurb: Another service does the same job without the machinery.

approaches.name: Find human-made
approaches.blurb: Places where the work is made by people, on purpose.

confidence.name: Reliable
confidence.blurb: An official setting, or a mechanism that has behaved consistently and is documented in several independent places.

confidence.name: Mostly works
confidence.blurb: Works for most people, but depends on your account, region, app version or a staged rollout.

confidence.name: Unreliable
confidence.blurb: Community-discovered behaviour. It may work today and stop tomorrow. Shown because it is genuinely useful when it works.

effort.blurb: One tap. Nothing to set up.
